# cb:b590

> `cb.verify.route_tags` re-derives each sink's excerpt log from the current route tags and fails on divergence, converting the log's freshness guarantee from procedural to structural; it also enforces that every ref resolves to a real artifact and every tagged sink carries its log. Tag coverage (that every feeding paragraph was tagged) stays editorial and is lifted only to row granularity by a routing-ledger cross-check.
